name: counterstrike
comment: CS:GO-inspired movement. Grounded: WASD converges toward a single camera-relative desired velocity (releasing a key removes stale drift). Airborne: momentum persists; speed only grows from a valid strafe (movement input + matching camera rotation). Holding Space auto-jumps. Strict mode = stationary-camera A/D does nothing. All values are in Mimita's scale (ground_speed 20, dt 1/60).

tuning_notes.comment: air_steering_rate_degrees_per_second = steering responsiveness (independent of speed gain). air_speed_gain_acceleration = how much a valid strafe adds. strafe_angular_tolerance_degrees = how far the wish may be from perpendicular to velocity. ground_direction_change_response = how fast stale lateral velocity is removed after releasing a key. speed_cap_mode none/hard/soft; hard caps only player-controlled bhop speed. All fields hot-reload.
